column1: # Nokia SR OS MIB bundles: proprietary (Nokia support portal only), so an optional local source.
# fetch.sh looks for each archive under $MIBLAB_NOKIA_DIR, verifies its sha256 and extracts MIBs/
# into corpus/src/nokia-sros/<release>/; a missing archive is skipped with a notice.
# role: flat = the newest release, competes for corpus/flat (source label "nokia");
#       history = older releases, indexed (instances.tsv, duplicates.tsv) but never chosen for corpus/flat
# Licence: never commit the MIB texts, only these paths/hashes and statistics.
#     docker image vr-sros:23.10.R1 (vrnetlab): layers = Debian base, qemu/bridge-utils, launch scripts and
#     sros-vm-23.10.R1.qcow2, whose FAT file system holds only TiMOS images (timos/*.tim, yang.tim) in a
#     packed proprietary format (no MIB text, no gzip/zip/xz members); bof.cfg, nvram.dat, syslinux.
#     So SR OS 23.10 contributes no MIBs; 19.7.R1 is the newest Nokia MIB bundle available locally.
